Huiyue Xu owns the retained deployment: promising at the exact midpoint of spring handing over to summer that on one hair-tip the boundless lands appear and the ten worlds do not leave the instant of the present thought — otherwise the seasons shorten one's life and the spirits envy one's blessing.

Senses.Explanation: The ten worlds and all times. Yuanwu Keqin opens his hall address with the tag and extends it — where there is no separation, the ten directions are the true realm; where there is no shifting, the ten worlds thread through what is before the eyes; Dahui Zonggao, eulogizing the Duchess of Qin, credits the saying to Elder Li — the boundless realm does not divide self from other by a hair-tip, the ten worlds do not leave the present thought — adding it is not forced, the dharma being thus; and Xueyan Zuqin, after telling the assembly that the living stand before the dead and the dead before the living, ancient and present each itself and yet one, seals it with the reversed variant — the ten worlds never depart from the present thought. Zhuanyu Guanheng praises a lay patron in a letter with the elders' tag, saying none who has not realized it can say it; Baiyu Jingsi splits the formula at the lantern festival — for one who gathers it there, the boundless seas divide self from other by no hair-tip; for one who does not, the ten worlds still never leave the present thought — then raises the whisk and shows the moon already late on the plum branch; Tian'an Sheng makes the formula the proof-sight of the single eye, in which every buddha and ancestor performs — miss the eye and the formula stays hard, an eye like a blind man's; Juelang Daosheng, seating Mara and Vimalakirti in one assembly, rules that the ten worlds do not leave the present thought, that one thought seen through makes everything interpenetrate, and dares them to raise that very deluded consciousness like a foe; and Huiyue Xu, at the exact midpoint of spring handing over to summer, promises that on one hair-tip the boundless lands appear and the ten worlds do not leave the instant of the present thought.
